corrections.text: The article quotes VentureBeat as saying: "Tenet Security found public evidence of the exposed setup at 48 organizations, six confirmed Fortune 500 companies." VentureBeat's original text reads: "Tenet found public evidence of the exposed setup at 48 organizations, six confirmed Fortune 500 companies" (no "Security"). The underlying figures (48 organizations, six confirmed Fortune 500) are accurate and independently confirmed in Tenet Security's own research post; only the quoted wording was inexact.
